name: whisper-base-komixv2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-base (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-05. Korean ASR fine-tune of openai/whisper-base (identical config.json: 6 encoder + 6 decoder layers, d_model 512, vocab 51,865; 72.59M params, same tensor set), trained 50,000 steps, batch 1024, lr 1e-4, on five AI-Hub Korean speech corpora (general, address, meeting, low-quality telephony, broadcast conversational). Recorded because the card prints a full size sweep in which every model appears twice - vanilla and komixv2 - so the base row sits in the same table as this row for all nine test sets. The table is inherited from rtzr/Awesome-Korean-Speech-Recognition with the conference-domain test set excluded. CAVEAT: the sweep shows this fine-tune beats whisper-base by a wide margin but is still behind whisper-large-v3 (7.99 average) and, at base size, behind whisper-small_komixv2 (7.36) - it is state-of-the-art among 74M models only. No licence tag on the repo; repo created 2025-02-26. The sibling records whisper-small-komixv2 and whisper-medium-komixv2 already exist and use the same table.
